criteria_verification.criterion_text: `close()` is idempotent and safe to call when client is None
criteria_verification.evidence: GraphitiClient.close() short-circuits when self._inner is None. On the first real close it captures inner, sets self._inner = None *before* awaiting (re-entrancy safety), then calls inner.close() inside try/except so a raising inner.close cannot propagate. Verified by test_close_is_safe_when_inner_is_none (None inner, two close() calls, no exception), test_close_calls_inner_close_exactly_once_then_zeros_state (asserts inner.close.assert_awaited_once() across two close() calls and client_or_none is None), and test_close_swallows_inner_close_exceptions.
